metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from Agulhas Labs. orchestration: a team of agents sized to the job, and a report of what they cost. cache-guard: a warning before the one message that costs twenty times the rest.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Run Claude Code like a lead with a team: cheap models do the specified work, an expensive one designs and reviews, and nothing is done until a command proves it. Includes agent-cost, which shows where your tokens went.

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Warns once before a message that will cost far more than usual: a large Claude Code context whose prompt cache has expired, or a model or effort change that resets it. Shows the estimated cost, and offers a handoff file written by a cheap model in the background so you can /clear instead.
